Package Fitness.ClientPackage

Class ProgramData

java.lang.Object
Fitness.ClientPackage.ProgramData
public class ProgramData extends Object
The ProgramData class provides a static method to retrieve a list of fitness programs.

Each program includes details such as its name, difficulty level, type, schedule, and duration. The class does not allow instantiation, as it is designed solely to offer utility methods related to fitness programs. This class encapsulates a collection of predefined programs and serves as a central point to access that data.

The class contains a private constructor to prevent instances from being created. Its only public method is getPrograms(), which returns a static list of fitness programs with their associated details.

Example usage: 

 List<Program> programs = ProgramData.getPrograms();

  • Method Details

    • getPrograms

      public static List<Program> getPrograms()
      Retrieves a list of predefined fitness programs with their associated details.

      This method returns a list of Program objects. Each program represents a fitness program with details such as its name, difficulty level, type, schedule, and duration. The programs returned are hardcoded and represent sample fitness programs for various levels of difficulty and types of fitness.

      Returns:
      a list of Program objects representing various fitness programs. Each program contains the following details:
      • Name: The name of the fitness program (e.g., "Yoga Basics")
      • Difficulty Level: The difficulty level of the program (e.g., "Beginner")
      • Type: The type or category of the program (e.g., "Flexibility", "Muscle Building")
      • Schedule: The list of available time slots for the program (e.g., "09:00 AM - 10:00 AM")
      • Duration: The duration of the program (start and end dates)
